_note: Discover → To do: what to do, where and why. 'done' is a key from public.my_activity_status(), 'enrolled:<course id>', or 'seen' (ticked when the player taps Go). 'core' items lead the first-visit pop-up and make up the red badge. {prize} is replaced with the current tournament prize.

items.title: Verify your email
items.where: Settings → Verify your email (we sent you a link)
items.why: Keeps your account safe and makes you eligible for the tournament prize and invite rewards.

items.title: Study for your student visa
items.where: Academic City: Brain University, Crescent University, Falcon University or the Foundation Academy
items.why: Graduate from any course and your 30-day visit visa becomes a 90-day student visa. No more overstay fines.

items.title: Get a job today
items.where: Job Board: City Metro and Marina Mall Group hire on the spot
items.why: A wage every Friday and the 2-year Employment visa. You can also ask staff in any café or shop.

items.title: Claim your Employment visa
items.where: Visa & budget tab, once you have a job
items.why: Two years of residency instead of a ticking visit visa.

items.title: Work a shift every day
items.where: Job Board → Your job → Work today's shift
items.why: You're paid for the shifts you work, and each one scores league points.

items.title: Move up to a better-paid job
items.where: Job Board: Gulf Hotels and Desert Tours (need a course), Swift Delivery (needs a licence), Falcon Analytics (needs a degree)
items.why: Earn up to AED 3,500 a week instead of AED 1,500.

items.title: Aim for the Freelance visa
items.why: Earn AED 360,000 and hold a degree for 5 years of self-sponsored residency.

items.title: Go for the 10-year Golden Visa
items.why: Own AED 2,000,000 of property bought with money you earned, or graduate with honours and run a venture with staff.

items.title: Learn Python
items.where: Brain University: Modern Full-Stack & Python Automation
items.why: Coding skills, a student visa when you graduate, and better jobs.

items.title: Learn AI and prompt engineering
items.where: Brain University: Applied AI & Prompt Engineering
items.why: The skill every employer wants right now.

items.title: Understand crypto and Web3
items.where: Brain University: Crypto, Web3 & VARA Compliance
items.why: Learn how digital assets and Dubai's rules work. Education, not investment advice.

items.title: Learn viral marketing
items.where: Brain University: Performance Marketing & Viral Growth
items.why: Grow a following and customers for your venture.

items.title: Become a content creator
items.where: Brain University: High-Value Content Creation & Personal Branding
items.why: Build a personal brand that opens doors.

items.title: Master high-ticket sales
items.where: Brain University: High-Ticket Closing & B2B Negotiation
items.why: Close bigger deals and negotiate better pay.

items.title: Get a business degree
items.where: Crescent University: Business & Entrepreneurship in Dubai
items.why: A degree unlocks Falcon Analytics jobs and the Freelance visa.

items.title: Learn property investing
items.where: Crescent University: Real Estate & Property Investment
items.why: Buy smarter on your way to the Golden Visa.

items.title: Learn cybersecurity
items.where: Falcon University: Cybersecurity & Digital Asset Protection
items.why: Protect your money and spot scams before they hit.

items.title: Learn Arabic and Dubai etiquette
items.where: Foundation Academy: Arabic for Newcomers & Dubai Etiquette
items.why: Feel at home faster. Graduating also earns a student visa.

items.title: Get sharper with money maths
items.where: Foundation Academy: Applied Mathematics & Financial Numeracy
items.why: Budgets, interest and VAT, the maths that keeps your runway long.

items.title: Learn UAE history and heritage
items.where: Desert Rose College: UAE Studies & National Heritage
items.why: Understand the country you now live in.

items.title: Start a book: Think and Grow Rich
items.why: A classic on ambition and wealth, one chapter a day with a quick quiz.

items.title: Read Atomic Habits
items.why: Tiny changes, remarkable results: build the habits that stick.

items.title: Read The Psychology of Money
items.why: Why people with good incomes still go broke, and how not to.

items.title: Read Rich Dad Poor Dad
items.why: Assets versus liabilities, explained simply.

items.title: Read How to Win Friends and Influence People
items.why: The people skills that make networking in Dubai easy.

items.title: Read Deep Work
items.why: Focus like a pro in a city full of distractions.

items.title: Read Mindset
items.why: Turn setbacks into progress with a growth mindset.

items.title: Get your driving licence
items.where: Driving Academy, Academic City: eye test, theory exam, Smart Yard parking
items.why: Unlocks cars in your Blueprint and driving jobs like Swift Delivery (AED 2,500 a week).

items.title: Practise real UAE road rules
items.why: 20 questions on speed limits, roundabouts, black points and more. Handy for a real test too.

items.title: Upgrade from metro card to a car
items.where: Visa & budget tab → Blueprint → Getting around
items.why: Drive yourself around the city once you're licensed. Watch what it does to your runway.

items.title: Keep 90+ days of runway
items.why: Earn the Financial Discipline Yield on your savings every week.

items.title: Cut costs before you run out
items.why: Under 14 days of runway is the Expat Trap. A cheaper flat or the metro buys you time.

items.title: Send money home
items.where: Visa & budget tab → Blueprint → Family support
items.why: Plan support for family the way real expats do, and see it in your daily costs.

items.title: Go clubbing, meet new people
items.why: Dance, chat and buy someone a drink. New friends unlock friend quests worth AED 2,000 each.

items.title: Add your first friend
items.where: Tap anyone in a venue, or Phone → People
items.why: Friends can visit your home, do weekly quests with you and join your crew.

items.title: Bring a friend to Dubai
items.where: People tab → Send my invite link
items.why: You both get AED 10,000 once they've played 3 days.

items.title: Do a friend quest
items.why: You and a friend both score 100 points in a week: AED 2,000 each.

items.title: Live with roommates
items.where: Visa & budget tab → Blueprint → Shared bed space
items.why: The cheapest rent in the city, and you're matched with roommates to befriend.

items.title: Treat someone
items.where: In any venue: tap a person → buy them a drink or send money
items.why: The fastest way to make a friend.

items.title: Go up the Burj Khalifa
items.why: The view everyone posts. Tick off Dubai's biggest landmark.

items.title: Shop at The Dubai Mall
items.why: 80+ shops for outfits and furniture, plus the aquarium.

items.title: Hit the beach
items.where: Kite Beach or Sunset Beach, Jumeirah
items.why: Work out, relax and lift your wellbeing to Peak Performer.

items.title: Eat out with friends
items.where: Time Out Market, Downtown, or Pier 7, Dubai Marina
items.why: Fill your hunger and meet people over food.

items.title: Ride the slides at Wild Wadi
items.why: Pure fun, a big boost to your mood.

items.title: See the Palm from above
items.why: The best photo spot in the city.

items.title: Sunset drinks at a beach bar
items.why: Live music, sunsets and new friends.

items.title: Beat a friend at Ludo
items.why: Quick, social and a great way to break the ice. Multiplayer wins score points.

items.title: Play Dubai Tycoon
items.why: Buy districts, build villas and bankrupt your rivals.

items.title: Play Draw & Guess with friends
items.why: The funniest game to play with a group.

items.title: Challenge someone to Chess
items.why: Prove you're the sharpest mind in Dubai.

items.title: Beat your high score
items.where: Game City: Tetris, Candy Crush, Snake
items.why: Play solo any time, no friends needed.

items.title: Take the 30-second scam check
items.why: Learn the red flags of fake police calls, toll fines and parcel fees.

items.title: Report a scam call
items.where: Your in-game phone, when a call or text arrives
items.why: Earn an AED 500–1,000 bounty instead of losing money.

items.title: Send the scam check to your family
items.why: Help the people you love spot real scams.

items.title: Decorate your home
items.why: Make your place yours, then show it off to friends.

items.title: Dress for the occasion
items.why: Outfits for work, nights out, the beach and formal events.

items.title: Rent or buy your own flat
items.where: Tap any tower on the map
items.why: Property bought with money you earned counts toward the Golden Visa.

items.title: Throw a house party
items.why: Friends rate your place and your wellbeing soars.

items.title: Open your own business
items.where: My ventures: karak café, food truck, barbershop, bistro, tech agency or yacht charter
items.why: Daily takings and a route to the Golden Visa.

items.title: Hire your first employee
items.why: Qualified staff who work shifts grow revenue up to 3×.

items.title: Start a crew with friends
items.why: Run a business together and split the profit, up to 5 partners.

items.title: Enter the monthly tournament
items.why: Free to enter. Everything you do scores points toward the prize: {prize}.

items.title: Climb your weekly league
items.why: Finish in the top 7 of 30 to move up a tier.

items.title: Claim your season rewards
items.why: Your points level up the season pass: free titles and AED.

items.title: Play every day
items.why: Keep your streak, unlock today's lesson and stay ahead on your visa.

items.title: Share your wins
items.where: Tap Share after a visa upgrade, a graduation or your licence
items.why: Friends who join through you earn you both AED 10,000.

items.title: Read How Dubai works
items.why: The visa ladder, money, jobs and prizes in one place.
